signal: PandaDoc is positioned as a leading DocuSign alternative in 2026 with its Salesforce-native document automation, CPQ and e-signature platform serving 55,000+ customers

email.body1:
Stephanie, saw PandaDoc is pulling demand as the go-to DocuSign alternative with your Salesforce-native CPQ and e-signature suite.

That kind of pull usually means more in-market accounts worth a conversation than your global team can reach before the moment passes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PandaDoc off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Stephanie, quick follow-up for PandaDoc.

With demand climbing globally, most sales leaders can't say how many meetings they actually need across regions to hit the number, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PandaDoc needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Stephanie, last bit of proof for PandaDoc.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PandaDoc's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Stephanie, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling global pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Riding a demand wave is its own kind of busy and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a document-automation motion? I'll tailor it to PandaDoc either way.
